low_repeated_stream_variability.draw_sd_definition: sample SD across paired draws (R-1 denominator)
low_repeated_stream_variability.draw_variance_definition: sample variance across paired draws (R-1 denominator)

matched_high_budget_reference.high_budget_reference_definition: mean paired estimate across high-budget draws for the same dataset-model-seed-scenario-severity cell
matched_high_budget_reference.mse_definition: mean squared low-estimate error against the matched high-budget reference; equivalently population draw variance plus squared finite-sample bias
matched_high_budget_reference.variance_definition: sample variance across repeated low paired estimates (R-1 denominator)

mid_high_convergence.interpretation: Descriptive mid-versus-high budget agreement; no undeclared acceptance threshold is imposed.

scope_note: Results characterize the paired LIME estimator only; no cross-method rank is produced.

threshold_agreement_top5.deployment_note: Estimator-agreement diagnostic; not deployment performance or ground-truth detection power.

within_block_spearman.design: draw-averaged values within dataset-model-seed-scenario blocks correlated across severity
